list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions and grades cross-checked between Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Counts such as 42 Shooting Range challenges are the counts PlayStation tracks for that trophy.
rarity_note: Rarity is Exophase's launch-day snapshot, 19 Nov 2026 about 15:00 UTC — the first hours after launch, when almost nobody had played far. It will rise fast; treat it as a launch-day record, not a live rate.

gtavicecityhub.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

ofzen.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this pops on its own. There is no shortcut: the road runs about 200 hours, most of it the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Work through the roadmap in order — story, side stories, activities, collectibles, then the 100% cleanup — and the Platinum is the last thing you earn.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy almost everyone earns — Exophase had it at 99.99% within hours of launch.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it does not fire the instant the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation — it is the one thing in the game you can miss (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Partner switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run, which is when most of the free-roam list opens up — but the chapter trophy itself only needs the story played through.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. While you are in Chapter 3, do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Yago's street racing strand the moment it appears (hourglass icon) — it counts toward Strangers & Freaks and will not wait.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. Near the end of this chapter, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens bank vault robberies — do it, because it unlocks Maximum Withdrawal and the vaults the 100% checklist needs.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Chapter 5. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission — if anything goes wrong with a trophy that needs a story moment, that save is your only way back.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after it, and from then on you can call the other one in as your partner — which the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best) all need.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Like every mission trophy, it is unmissable — play the story and it pops.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Mission trophies cannot be missed; they unlock as the story is played.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Mission trophies cannot be missed; they unlock as the story is played.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Mission trophies cannot be missed; they unlock as the story is played.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Mission trophies cannot be missed; they unlock as the story is played.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist has 35 tasks and only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but work you do earlier still counts. The thresholds are lenient (about 60% of true completion, per PowerPyx): 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. It is the hardest trophy in the game and the last one most hunters earn before the Platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, so mix them up rather than grinding one kind. Do not stop at 250: the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going while you are in the habit.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each activity type the game tracks — nine types in all. Play one round of each: a race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, a drone race, a shooting range session and the rest. You do not need to win any of them, just try each once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the game's two shooting ranges. This is the hardest skill trophy in the list: learn each weapon class's rhythm, use the range's own scoring quirks, and take the challenges one weapon at a time instead of grinding them all in one sitting.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. You only need one win per location, so learn each course's line once, win it, and move on. The races are one of the nine activity types for Master of None, so your first race there counts twice.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street races, and any other race type the game offers. Each race only counts once, so work through the list rather than replaying the one you like. Yago's street racing strand is a good place to start, and its Chapter 3 race against Yago is time-sensitive, so do it when it appears.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, and this was the most-earned non-story trophy on launch day (1.89% on Exophase) — it is available early and it is straightforward. Learn the reeling rhythm, keep the line tension in the safe zone, and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts, so pick the one you are best at and play it through to the end. Arcade games are one of the nine activity types, so this also ticks one off Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline through its final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only. All six side-story finales stay available after the credits, so there is no rush — but note that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because they have their own trophies.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline through its final mission. Kenton is one of the six side-story characters whose finale carries its own trophy, and the finale stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline through its final mission. Like the other side-story finales, it stays available after the credits. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every questline counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish so you know which ones counted. One strand is time-sensitive — the Chapter 3 Race Against Yago, marked with an hourglass icon — so race it the moment it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline through its final mission. Like the other side-story finales, it stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline through its final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only. It stays available after the credits, and it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after she is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time), follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Do it, and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt wants. The finale stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you explore rather than leaving them all for the cleanup, and keep a checklist of which sets you have finished so you do not chase cards you already own.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations across Leonida. This pairs naturally with Whip It Good: scanning a vehicle with WAiNK counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and the two trophies fill up together. Work through the map region by region so you do not keep re-covering the same ground.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, listed under Progress, then Challenges. Many complete on their own while you play, so check the list before grinding any one type. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so do not stop at 50 — keep ticking them off toward 70.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. The easiest way is a bank vault job: escaping a vault gives you 4 stars straight away, so do it with your partner alongside (see Maximum Withdrawal). The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area — keep driving until the stars are gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so keep the heat up and move fast between shops. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of hunting vehicles one by one. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aim you trigger by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of enemies standing close together, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus, so pop it before you start.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (a Rhino). Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. A vault job gives you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so keep going past 5.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash and get clear of the heat. Armored trucks are the same ones you tail for the bank vault jobs, so you will know how they move by the time you need one.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. This fills in as you travel for other trophies — the card sets, the WAiNK locations, the meditation spots and the stranger strands all pull you across the map. Check the map for the areas you have not set foot in yet and sweep them up during the cleanup.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are the gang-run fronts scattered across Leonida — Kingpin Bowling, for example, is one of them. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this trophy pops along the way to that.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — no guide had a verified trigger when this entry was built (19 Nov 2026). The description is the only hint: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Try ordering a cocktail at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and taking in the view; it may pop while you play normally. This entry will be updated once a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — no guide had a verified trigger when this entry was built (19 Nov 2026). The description is the only hint, and it reads like the classic showroom smash from the series' past: drive a car through a vehicle showroom's glass front and out the other side. Inferred from the description, not yet confirmed — try it at a showroom in Vice City.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: REPORTED, NOT YET CONFIRMED (19 Nov 2026): it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. The description is vague by design, so treat the gym route as the best current report, not a certainty.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: REPORTED, NOT YET CONFIRMED (19 Nov 2026): PlayStation tracks a count to 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it should fill up without a separate grind as you play through the rest of the list. Check the trophy's progress counter as you go.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — no guide had a verified trigger when this entry was built (19 Nov 2026). The description is the only hint: 'Second time's the charm.' The likeliest reading is succeeding at something on a second attempt — a failed-then-retried moment — but that is an inference, not a confirmed method. It may pop while you play normally.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — no guide had a verified trigger when this entry was built (19 Nov 2026). The description is the only hint: 'What the hell just happened?' It points to a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida — the kind of odd moment the series hides off the beaten path. Explore the weird corners of the map and it may pop on its own.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — no guide had a verified trigger when this entry was built (19 Nov 2026). The description is the only hint, and it reads plainly: knock someone down with a melee weapon during a drive-by. Inferred from the description, not yet confirmed — try a melee drive-by on a pedestrian from a slow-moving car.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs — sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds up across the whole playthrough as you rob vaults and trucks.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it fills up naturally as you buy weapons, clothes, car upgrades and the rest. If you are short at the end, the garages for Little Boxes and the gym membership for Personal Best both count toward it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count — only the ones you buy. Buy them before you start registering cars for On the Spot, since each registered car needs a free garage space.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes) and register cheap cars.
